vetSays.line: 🛡️ Felipe, the person in their 60s, with sun-creased eyes, the soldier, Wanjiru and Nino met them at the door — 4 put down. Felipe, Wanjiru, Nino are hurt.
🛡️ Hazel, Felipe, Tanya, Paluku and Were met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Hazel, Felipe, Tanya, Paluku, Were are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Felipe, Wanjiru, Miguel, Elif and Nino met them at the door — 5 put down. Felipe, Wanjiru, Miguel, Elif, Nino are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jesse just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elif just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
